subject: Discovery follow-up: VP/CTO intro to unblock next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up + VP/CTO intro to unblock next steps

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the time today — great to learn more about Acme's large-scale search and summarization use case. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Summary: You're running a mix of in-house and open models for retrieval-augmented generation, with primary pain around latency spikes during peak traffic and cost predictability across environments (hosted + Private/VPC).
- What matters: predictable p99 latency, ability to run private deployments for regulated datasets, and a clear migration plan for our most used embedding pipelines.

Next steps I recommend: 
1) Technical deep dive/demo with Priya (CTO) and your infra team — show Dedicated and Private deployment options plus an ops walkthrough on batching and KV caching.
2) Exec alignment (VP/CTO intro) to unblock procurement questions and pre-approve compliance scope.

Would you be open to a 45–60 minute technical demo + VP intro next week? Below are a few slots I have open (PST):
- Tue 6/18 10:00–11:00
- Wed 6/19 13:00–14:00
- Thu 6/20 16:00–17:00

I'm copying Priyom (solutions) who can run the demo and bring a short slide deck and a short runbook for migration cost estimates. I've attached a one-page pricing/term sheet and a short checklist of security artifacts we typically share (SOC2, logging, KMS integrations).

Attachments: redwood-pricing-term-sheet.pdf (1 page), acme-security-questionnaire.pdf (requested template)

Thanks — looking forward to continuing this.

Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@acmecorp.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + VP/CTO intro to unblock next steps

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming that the themes you captured are right. Priya is on copy and would like to sit in on the technical demo. Her calendar is a bit tight next week, but she has a couple windows. 

Priya's preferred times (PST):
- Tue 6/18 10:00–10:45 (can extend if needed)
- Wed 6/19 15:00–16:00

If you can make Tue 6/18 10:00 that would be great — we can start with a 30–45 minute technical session and then bring in a couple procurement folks if we need to cover terms.

Quick note: procurement asked for the security questionnaire and a list of controls we can map to their vendor assessment — thanks for sending that.

Jordan
Director of Product, AcmeCorp
jordan.smith@acmecorp.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acmecorp.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 10:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + VP/CTO intro to unblock next steps

Perfect — Tue 6/18 10:00 PST works for us. I'll put a 60-minute block on the calendar to allow for the demo + brief exec alignment. 

Priyom will lead the demo and cover:
- Serving runtime and how we handle p99 latency (KV caching, continuous batching)
- Dedicated vs Private deployment tradeoffs and KMS/HSM integration notes
- Cost/throughput examples and a short migration runbook

I'm copying Vivek (VP of Sales) to join the exec portion and help with procurement/contract questions. Vivek — Jordan and Priya at Acme; they're evaluating Redwood for a mix of hosted + private deployments. We agreed to Tue 6/18 10:00–11:00 PST. Can you join for the first 20–30 minutes?

Thanks all — calendar invite to follow.

Marissa

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks for the intro, Marissa. I'm Vivek, VP Sales at Redwood. Looking forward to the discussion on Tue. Suggested agenda for the first 20–30 minutes:

1) Quick exec introductions (5 min)
2) Top-level business objectives and success metrics Acme wants from an inference partner (10 min)
3) Proposed procurement timeline and decision owners (5–10 min)

Priyom — appreciate you leading the demo. If helpful, we can cover pricing guardrails and any enterprise purchasing flex (credits, pilot terms) at the end.

Also attaching the pricing/term sheet referenced earlier for quick review.

Attachment: redwood-pricing-term-sheet.pdf

Regards,

All — thanks, that works. I've accepted the Tue 6/18 10:00–11:00 PST invite and added procurement (Sam Lee) as optional. Priya — look forward to the demo.

Two quick asks before the meeting: 
1) Can you include a slide or two on the typical SOC2 evidence mapping we provide? Our procurement team will want to see that up front.
2) If you can pre-share a short appendix with estimated token-unit costs for our 3 workload profiles (search-high-QPS, summarization-batch, embeddings) that would help speed the procurement review.

I'll share an internal calendar note with our infra and procurement attendees.

Jordan
